verdict.rationale: The evidence implies Raygun ships its own client instrumentation across platforms. There is a JavaScript crash-reporting language guide with source-map support for web frontends, and dSYM and ProGuard uploads for iOS and Android crash symbolication. Sensitive data can be filtered before errors are sent from your application, and a community user praises .NET and WinRT support picking up errors in a Windows Store app. However, no item explicitly documents official SDKs or automatic capture of uncaught errors. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of official SDKs per platform (frontend, backend, mobile), documentation that uncaught errors are captured automatically without manual calls, and recent independent hands-on corroboration.
